craft_notes: Sthāyin: aids-verse (mudrā-like tools). Sanskrit: śikhipakṣaiś...śūnyapañcakam...praveśo hṛdaye bhavet → L4 lists aids then lands entry-in-heart. Rows: row 1 (aids uncut). Close: heart (entry location). Rejected: 'peacock-plume' flourish — killed: feathers kept (literal tools); 'chakra-talk' — killed: five-void kept (śūnyapañcaka — not chakras).

lines: Peacock feathers, varied forms, circles — five-void:
of the meditating, unsurpassed void: entry in heart.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śikhipakṣaiś citrarūpair ma.ṅdalaiḥ śūnyapañcakam | dhyāyato 'nuttare śūnye praveśo hṛdaye bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What aids entry? → In the unsurpassed void, meditation gives entry in heart.
c1_essence: Feathers, forms, circles: in unsurpassed void, entry in heart.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
